payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all prefix positions of the robot's unblocked path; for each, set as obstacle and simulate the full command sequence; return the first position that leads back to (0,0).
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates candidate obstacle positions taken from the path visited without obstacles, then simulates the commands for each. This brute-force scanning of a finite set of possibilities aligns with complete search enumeration, despite not being strictly permutation enumeration.
